Shanghai Municipal Police. （印：整 35）

Hongkew Station.
June 13, 192 5.

REPORT ON Communistic matters.

Made by P. C. C. Kedrolivansky. Forwarded by

Sir,

I beg to report, that according to various informers, agitation work of the Soviet agents is proceeding as follows:

Mr. Yui (于) Director of the "Shanghai University" arrived from Peking on 8th inst and brought instructions from Karahan which are to the effect that all actions of Student's communistic organisation should be carried out under the cloak of patriotism, inasmuch as the Communistic leaders are of the opinion that only patriotic and anti-foreign ideas can cause an uprising of the Chinese people. Bolshevik ideas, which are difficult to understand will be opposed by the Chinese militarists.

On 9th and 11th June meetings of Russian and Chinese agitators took place at the Ah Toong Da Aud. college (亞東大學) situated somewhere near Chinese City's West Gate. During the meeting on 11th inst. Chinese student Chu Dah Yee (邱達義) said that he was organising among the students a party to be known as the "Sacred vengeance". The aim of this party is to punish and generally terrorise foreigners.

Part of "Agitotdel" headed by Mr. Chercassoff has been transferred to Hong Feng Road (華丰路) Chapel.

In the above mentioned place the most active Chinese student's organisation are gathered. My informer stated, that "Allied Committee of Merchant Student and Workmen's delegates" (工商学聯合會) situated in Li Teh Middle School, near West Gate are under the influence of the above mentioned Student's organisation and are
